name: Rokumonji Megu
source:
Owner and manager of the confectionery store Primrose. After returning from France, she and Chiharu started to manage "Primrose", a confectionary store where customers can eat in.

She has a strong connection with the people of the shopping association in the town and seems to have the aptitude for running a business. The store seems to be doing quite well.

She is especially particular about coffee, and handles everything from purchasing beans to roasting and brewing. Her jewel-like coffee, brewed drop by drop with a flannel in one hand, is enough to make even the most discerning coffee connoisseur gasp.

[From [url=http://www.studio-74.net/works/works-patisserie.html]official site[/url]]
